name: Insomniac
description: The commander barely sleeps; the night is his to use, at a price.
upside: Night slot always available (not only on events).
downside: -1 effective Empathy rank on the day after a sleepless night.

name: Old Wound
description: He has been hurt before and it shows; the squad respects that, and so does the next fight.
upside: Seasoning +1 at start; Trust gains +15% for the first 14 days ("he's seen worse").

name: Silver Tongue
description: Words come easily to him, and so do half-truths.
downside: Units with the trigger "lies" punish a detected lie harder.

name: Pretty Face
description: People notice him first and judge him second.
downside: Trust gains -10% for the first 14 days ("corporate doll").

name: Bookish
description: He learns from files and people before he learns from drills.

name: Field Medic
description: He was trained to patch people up, and they remember who did.
upside: Medbay actions with a unit give +Affinity; Empathy starts at rank 2.

name: Corporate Polish
description: He speaks the corporation's language fluently, which opens doors and closes hearts.
upside: +1 Leash authorization per week; oversight standing +.
downside: Units whose values lean against the corporation start with Trust -10.

name: Street-Raised
description: He grew up below the corporate floors and knows how things really get done.
upside: Cunning starts at rank 2; requisition prices -15%.
downside: Corporate standing -; the Leash is approved less often.

name: Vow of Distance
description: AUTHOR TO WRITE: a vow that keeps the commander from anything romantic and makes a deeper kind of closeness possible.
upside: Platonic closeness comes 15% easier; a unique platonic bond (sworn) becomes possible.
